description:
Curated B. rapa gene sets from BRAD with their Arabidopsis counterparts and references: flowering (141),
glucosinolate (111), anthocyanin (82), auxin (343), resistance (NBS-LRR, 245) and transcription factors (by
family). B. rapa IDs are Chiifu v1.5 (= Ensembl Plants B. rapa, Bra000001). category: one of flowering,
glucosinolate, anthocyanin, auxin, resistance, transcription_factor; query: words matched to symbol, family and
annotation (e.g. 'FLC', 'MYB28', 'TIR-NBS-LRR', 'MADS'); gene: a Bra or AT ID. No arguments: counts.
name: brad_gene_sets
